# Keyboard and mouse shortcuts Keyboard shortcuts are keys or combinations of keys that provide an alternative way to do something in the Solidatus Model Viewer. Where a shortcut includes one or more `+` signs, you need to press and hold several keys simultaneously. Mouse shortcuts require you to click a mouse button, and possibly also press a key on the keyboard. {% hint style="success" %} Multiple entries indicate alternative shortcuts for the same action. {% endhint %} We’ve grouped our shortcuts into four categories to help you find the one you want. ## Navigating and selecting | Navigate among entities | Select an entity, then use the Arrow keys | | ------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | Select range of entities |
